title: NOX METALS vs Metals Depot for Aluminum Plate
summary: Metals Depot sells aluminum online with no minimum order in any quantity and any size. NOX METALS stocks certified aerospace plate in thick sections with DFARS documentation. Which one fits your job.
body_markdown:
### Does Metals Depot have a minimum order?


No. They state no minimum order and sell in any quantity, which is one of the genuinely good things about their store. NOX METALS also has no minimum, including single pieces of 7075 and 7050.


### Does Metals Depot sell 7075 aluminum plate?


7075 appears in their broader aluminum lineup, but their aluminum plate page lists 3003, 5052, and 6061. For 7075 or 7050 plate in thick sections with mill certs and DFARS documentation, you want a supplier that stocks aerospace plate as a core category.


### Who is cheaper for aluminum plate?


For thin general-purpose material Metals Depot is usually the cheaper and more appropriate answer. For thick plate and for anything that fits an existing certified drop in our inventory, we are typically well below cut-to-size pricing, often 20 to 40 percent below on the drop. The alloys barely overlap, so the comparison rarely comes down to price.


### Does Metals Depot provide mill certificates?


They do not publish a certification program. If your job requires mill certs with heat numbers, lot traceability, or DFARS melt-source documentation, confirm in writing before ordering from any supplier. We ship certs with every order by default.


### I need aluminum diamond plate cut to size. Can NOX METALS do that?


No. We stock aluminum plate at 0.25 inch and thicker and do not carry diamond plate, tread plate, or thin sheet. Metals Depot sells diamond plate cut to size and is the right supplier for that.
